kicker.zh: 型号 / 接口 / 材料

intro.en: Find a cable model or material part number, then send it for a custom replacement or original-part sourcing review.
intro.zh: 按成品型号或材料料号查找，提交编号即可沟通兼容替代件制作或原厂件采购。

search_label.en: Find a model or part number

search_placeholder.en: Brand, model, part number or product type
search_placeholder.zh: 输入品牌、型号、料号或产品类型

empty.en: No matching references. Try a brand, full part number or a listed alias.
empty.zh: 未找到匹配项，请尝试品牌、完整料号或已列出的别名。

intro.en: Sensor and actuator interconnect cable assemblies.
intro.zh: 传感器与执行器互连电缆组件。

intro.en: Circular and fieldbus connector components for interface selection.
intro.zh: 用于接口选型的圆形及现场总线连接材料。

checks_title.en: Six Decisions Behind the Part Number
checks_title.zh: 型号背后的六个选型要点

copy.en: Identify power, analog, digital and communication circuits before mapping the connector.
copy.zh: 先区分电源、模拟、数字及通信回路，再确定接口定义。

copy.en: Confirm mating series, coding, contact count and sensor-side pin assignment.
copy.zh: 确认对插系列、编码、触点数量及传感器端针脚分配。

copy.en: Specify pair construction, shield continuity and the equipment grounding path.
copy.zh: 明确线对结构、屏蔽连续性及设备接地路径。

copy.en: Set connector orientation, branch points and service access around the installed instrument.
copy.zh: 围绕仪表安装位置确定接头方向、分支点与检修空间。

copy.en: Review temperature, fluids, vibration and movement before choosing cable and protection.
copy.zh: 选线与防护前核对温度、介质、振动及运动工况。

copy.en: Agree continuity and pin-map checks, then define any signal-specific acceptance tests.
copy.zh: 约定导通与针脚检查，并制定相应信号的验收项目。

boundary.en: Send the part number, drawing or sample to confirm the replacement configuration and sourcing plan.
boundary.zh: 请提供型号、图纸或样品，具体替代配置与原厂件采购方案按项目确认。

text.en: Send the model or part number to discuss your project.
text.zh: 提交型号或料号，沟通您的定制与采购需求。
